section_title: What would make LinkedIn worth it?
section_intro: Choose the support you need. Agree what useful would look like.
value_label: Five value hypotheses to agree and observe. They are separate kinds of value, not stages of one funnel or promised results.

beats.title: Less time finding the time.
beats.pain: Your week is full of product decisions and customer conversations. Turning them into posts becomes another job.
beats.approach: Regular source interviews, writing and an agreed review workflow turn those decisions into content you can approve.
beats.signal: Compare your time before and during the work, including interviews, questions and approvals.

beats.title: Be known by the people who matter.
beats.pain: Reactions from familiar names can hide a harder question: do the people who could buy know what you are building?
beats.approach: Align your profile, themes and distribution choices around the roles, companies and questions that matter to your business.
beats.signal: Look for relevant new connections and buyers who recall a specific publication.

beats.eyebrow: Keep the thinking behind the product
beats.title: Keep your thinking in the story.
beats.pain: Broad claims about AI and automation can sound interchangeable. Polished writing can lose the person behind it.
beats.approach: Use your decisions, trade-offs and evidence to write in a voice you recognize.
beats.signal: Ask whether a buyer can name the story, opinion or explanation that gave them a reason to talk.

beats.eyebrow: Bring useful stories out of the company
beats.title: Bring the useful stories outside.
beats.pain: A customer finds an unexpected use. Your team makes a difficult choice. The story stays inside a call or a message thread.
beats.approach: Develop permissioned stories, walkthroughs and visual explanations that connect the work to a buyer’s question.
beats.signal: Record when sales uses a specific publication in a deal and how the buyer responds.

beats.eyebrow: Give the next conversation a reason
beats.title: Give the next conversation a reason.
beats.pain: Inconsistent prospecting and generic openings leave the other person with little reason to reply.
beats.approach: Connect founder content with relevant, reviewed conversation starters and follow-up material. Account actions require an agreed scope.
beats.signal: Count suitable dialogues about a real problem and held demos separately. Record the next step.

why_title: We understand the product behind your story.
why_body: Our technical background helps us follow the decisions and details behind what you are building. We connect that substance to a buyer’s question while keeping your thinking and voice intact.
responsibility_note: Before work starts, agree interview cadence, preparation, approvals, deliverables and permissions. The current business source leaves the process and responsibility split open.
status: Local reviewed candidate; owner acceptance pending; source supports rationale, not independently verified team capacity.
